title: GURPS Martial Arts
label: GURPS Martial Arts
notes: GCA cites this book as MA65, and a record the Basic Set also prints as MA65, B230; those are left to the system's packs. PDF page = book page + 1. The Extra Attack modifier is p. 44 of [MODIFIERS]; the rest of that section is equipment and combat-table bookkeeping. The parsers do not read the file's templates or its Art and Sport skill directives, so styles, character templates and those skills are kept by hand. Techniques for an open skill, techniques off a defense or attribute, and attack modes with the unarmed damage bonus wait on sargas79/GWorldVTT#194-#196. See TRIAGE.md.
